No, I want something with a bit of flavour, like fruit juice.
Who has fruit juice? I do not know.
The administration pantry seems to have apple juice.

Alright, I will go to the supermarket and buy some right now.
No need, go on with your work, I will go look myself.
Which way is the pantry?
To the left.

examples.text: 他的习惯是不带实习生的。
examples.trans: His habit is never taking on interns.

examples.text: 最后留下的概率并不是很高。
examples.trans: The chance of staying on at the end is really not very high.

examples.text: 你也不用太悲观了，可以试试云海卫视。
examples.trans: You do not need to be too pessimistic either; you can try Yunhai Television.

examples.text: 不要太着急了，招聘竞争都很激烈。
examples.trans: Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.

examples.trans: I just heard her making a phone call — she is going to betray Director Chun Yu!

examples.text: 我放弃电视台，去星天娱乐。
我还约了人，你们先回去吧。
examples.trans: I also have an appointment with someone; you two head back first.

examples.text: 公司附近那家店的咖啡味道不错。
examples.trans: The coffee at that shop near the office tastes great.
The flavour of this fish dish is wonderful.

examples.trans: Excuse me, which way is the admin pantry?

examples.text: 舞台入口在左边还是在哪边？
examples.trans: Is the stage entrance on the left or which side?

examples.text: 李先生好像很满意小谷的安排。
examples.trans: Mr Li seems pleased with Xiaogu's arrangements.

examples.text: 你早晚会成长的，要对自己有信心。
examples.trans: Sooner or later you will grow; you need to have confidence in yourself.

examples.text: 那儿就是淳于乔的总编室。
examples.trans: Over there is Chun Yuqiao's chief editor's office.

examples.text: 行政部的茶水间就在左边。
examples.trans: The administration pantry is right on the left.

examples.text: 请坐在舞台左边的嘉宾先发言。
examples.trans: Guests seated on the left of the stage may speak first.

examples.text: 小谷，对不起啊，把你的本子都弄脏了。
examples.trans: Xiaogu, I am so sorry — I got your notebook all dirty.

examples.text: 我看他们太忙了，就想上去帮把手。
examples.trans: I saw they were too busy, so I wanted to step up and lend a hand.

examples.text: 我想问一下，方教授在哪办公啊？
examples.trans: May I ask where Professor Fang has his office?

examples.text: 今天早上他们发了官方声明。
examples.trans: They issued an official statement this morning.

examples.text: 星天有很多部门，这些部门之间都是平行的。
examples.trans: Xingtian has many departments, and all of these departments are on equal footing.

examples.trans: I want something with flavour, like fruit juice.

examples.text: 冰箱里还有两瓶冰镇果汁。
examples.trans: There are still two bottles of chilled juice in the fridge.

examples.text: 我先去给你打点温开水吧。
examples.trans: Let me go get you some warm boiled water first.

examples.text: 上台唱歌之前喝口温开水润润嗓子。
examples.trans: Sip some warm water to soothe your throat before singing.

examples.text: 见什么都要看看，不好意思啊。
examples.trans: Whatever I see, I cannot help taking a look — sorry about that.
In a little while you will find out.

examples.text: 职场里边很复杂，你听我的，先顾自己。
examples.trans: Inside the workplace things are complicated; listen to me and look after yourself first.

examples.text: 行政部的茶水间好像有苹果汁。
examples.trans: The administration pantry seems to have apple juice.

examples.text: 魔鬼鱼今天居然想要喝苹果汁！
examples.trans: Manta Ray actually wants to drink apple juice today!

examples.text: 行政部的茶水间就在走廊左边。
examples.trans: The admin pantry is right down the hall on the left.

examples.text: 休息的时候大家喜欢去茶水间冲杯咖啡。
examples.trans: On breaks everyone likes making coffee in the pantry.

examples.text: 干咱们这行，谁不想跟他学习？

examples.trans: The company has no separate admin department.

examples.text: 行政部负责采购办公用品。
examples.trans: The admin department handles office supplies.

examples.text: 你们俩要做好思想准备。
examples.trans: The two of you need to be mentally prepared.

examples.text: 行，我现在就去楼下超市买苹果汁。
examples.trans: Alright, I will go down to the supermarket right now to buy juice.

examples.text: 下班顺路去超市买点水果和牛奶吧。
examples.trans: Let us stop by the supermarket after work for fruit and milk.
